title: Seller Adjustment Allowance
description: A bounded change the buyer pre-authorizes in commercial_terms, bound by terms_digest, that the seller may apply unilaterally to one purchase as a new revision. Outside the bounds the seller sends an offer. Experimental in AdCP 3.3 (media_buy.seller_adjustment_allowances).

allowance_id.description: Identifier unique within the commercial terms. Applied adjustments and change records cite it.

purchase_index.description: Position in commercial_terms.purchases that this allowance covers.

min_notice.description: Minimum lead time before the end of the purchase flight (budget_release) or before the scheduled time of the item moved (schedule_shift).

max_release_fraction.description: budget_release only. Ceiling on the cumulative release, as a fraction of the purchase budget in the terms that introduced this allowance.

max_shift.description: schedule_shift only. Largest move, earlier or later, from the agreed time.

alternates.description: schedule_shift only. Ordered pre-approved alternates (broadcast line alternates). The seller MUST use the first available one.

label.description: Display name, such as the program title.

examples.description: Release up to 20% of the purchase budget when under-delivering, with 7 days' notice
Broadcast line alternates for a primary program
